notes: Diagnostic problematic, not independent finance-expert validation. The answer handles the opposing segment underwriting evidence and actual blocked state, but it falsely rejects expense/operating leverage merely because consolidated expenses rose. Revenues increased 245 USD million (about 3.51%), expenses 173 (about 3.01%), and pretax income 72; the selected accounting bridge shows positive leverage on a GAAP consolidated basis, regardless of whether it is durable or underwriting-driven. The tax caveat is also overbroad: tax expense falls 251 to 238 while pretax income rises 1,246 to 1,318, so the displayed effective tax ratio is calculable and falls about 20.14% to 18.06%.
